variation in height, depth or frontage along one terrace, within one architectural language
the ground between the terraces belonging to somebody
the ground each side is prepared on being ground its buildings can be founded on, with the step between the two fabrics a seam a person can walk

preregistered.written_before: any new candidate was compiled, anything was built or read
preregistered.model: no API key and no retrieval provider is configured; the terminal agent answers every staged job.

section_extent.registered_as: a block-sized rectangle spanning the boundary gate and both inhabited fabrics, chosen for its ground
section_extent.why_here: measured on the observed baseline `out/nb-city/world.before-plateau.npz` before the round ran: 11,211 columns, 4.7% standing water, bed from y=35 to y=104, and 72% of it within eight blocks of its own median and dry. The gate `ring_gate_middle_ring` stands at (-5761, 692), 39 columns from the nearest edge, so the selection rule's 16-column clearance is kept. The three alternatives measured beside it are recorded in the round report: the neighbourhood round's own block west of the gate (5,265 columns, 16.1% wet, no gate, one fabric), the middle ring's wettest run east of it (6,771 columns, 18.4% wet, no gate), and the crowded ring's east end (4,209 columns, 8.3% wet, one fabric). This one is the only candidate that carries the gate, both fabrics, the boundary and the grade together, which is what `the wet/grade/entrance interface that broke construction` names.
section_extent.out_of_scope: everything the section is for: the whole of both fabrics, the market, the continuous route from the outer gate, whole-city identity

expectations.ground_first: the block's districts are terraced at the level `placeplan.district_ground` chose for them and their counts are derived from `placeplan.developable_columns` over the ground that can carry a building, not over the rectangle
expectations.architecture_not_labels: every functional claim rests on a final-world predicate run on the assembled world after all construction
expectations.outcome: a built, checked and inspected block whose ground, street, frontage and roofline can be looked at and improved cheaply -- or a stop naming what could not be laid and why

preregistered.seeded_from: out/sd-city, copied after its plan, ground, terraces and circulation: the block shares the city's plan, its prepared ground and its roads and differs only in which extent is built, which is what makes it cheap enough to be the iteration unit
